profile.summary: Modern Threads (India) Limited manufactures and sells wool and blended worsted yarn products in India. It offers merino raw white and dyed re-combed wool tops; polyester/wool blended dyed re-combed tops; specialty and worsted woolen yarns; lanolin; wool grease; synthetic yarn; and wool noil and spinning waste products.
